learning_outcomes.text: Basic knowledge and application of environmental technologies and sustainability.
Knowledge and capabilities for applying energy saving and efficiency systems in mechanical machines and installations.
Demonstrate the ability to analyze and synthesize.
Acquire the ability to solve problems effectively.
Acquire skills related to the use of computer programs for calculation, data analysis and processing, within their field of application.
Develop the ability to work in a team.
Ability to apply knowledge to practice.
Acquire the ability for autonomous learning and concern for knowledge and continuous training.

Ability to write and develop projects in the field of mechanical engineering, for the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical installations, industrial installations and plants and manufacturing processes.
Ability to interpret technical projects and reports.
Ability to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.

syllabus_topics: Generalities on thermal machines: Initial definitions. Classification of thermal machines.

Working cycles in reciprocating internal combustion engines. Introduction. Real or indicated cycle. Theoretical cycles. Efficiencies. Indicated parameters of reciprocating internal combustion engines.
Determination of fundamental magnitudes. Engine testing. Engine characteristic curves. Energy balance in the engine. Cooling systems. Lubrication.
Charge renewal processes: Charge renewal in 4-stroke engines. Charge renewal in 2-stroke engines. Engine supercharging.

Combustion in reciprocating internal combustion engines. Fuels. Combustion in spark-ignition engines. Combustion in compression-ignition engines. Fuel supply systems. Ignition system. Diesel injection systems.
Steam turbines. Introduction. Thermodynamic cycles in steam turbines. Real energy balance of a power plant with a steam turbine.
Gas turbines. Introduction. Brayton cycle. Real energy balance of a gas turbine. Combined cycle power plants.
Jet engines. Rocket engine. Thrust expression. Air-breathing jet engines. Turbojet engines.
Introduction to Cogeneration. Cogeneration systems. Fundamental parameters. Fuel cells.
Environmental impact of thermal machines. Environmental impact of energy development. Environmental impact of fuels. Environmental impact of thermoelectric and nuclear energies.
teaching_methods: Completion of assignments, reports, memoirs and assessment tests

assessment_methods.method: Assessment of Teamwork Report and Oral Presentation of Works

assessment_rules: The evaluation is based on continuous assessment. A minimum score of 5 out of 10 is required for the theoretical-practical exam (with 33% in each part), 4 out of 10 for practical sessions, and 5 out of 10 for the teamwork report and oral presentation. Practical sessions and continuous individual assessment are not recoverable in the second sitting. If minimums are not met, the global grade will be the weighted average, unless it exceeds 4.9, in which case the global grade will be 4.9. In the second sitting, the theoretical-practical exam can be retaken, and the teamwork report and oral presentation can be submitted/performed.
